stages.title: Feasibility and concept design
stages.text: Site studies, the brief and the design of the building.

stages.title: Pre-project approval
stages.duration: A few weeks to a few months
stages.text: The municipality is reviewing the pre-project (anteproyecto).

stages.title: Construction documents and official pre-sale
stages.text: Detailed construction drawings are prepared while the official pre-sale opens.

stages.title: Move in
stages.text: Homes are handed over fully furnished and ready to live in. An optional package adds tableware, décor and plants.
